_readme: The one file to edit by hand. Everything else in the README is fetched: repos from GitHub, projects from the onehublabs repo.
what_i_do: I'm a full-stack developer and product manager for e-commerce and product data. I take a product from the problem to production: I scope it, build the front end, back end and data pipelines, and run it.

Most recently I owned supplier feeds and marketplace integrations at DeinDeal, a Swiss marketplace: managing Channable, onboarding suppliers, building the Galaxus integration, and writing the code and tooling around them.

One example of how I work: product translation was a manual bottleneck outside my role, so I built an AI application that automates the whole process. It has translated 800,000+ products into four languages.
skills: scoping, prioritisation, stakeholder and supplier communication, shipping end to end.
React, Astro, TypeScript, Tailwind, GSAP scroll and SVG animation, design systems, three-language sites.
Laravel, PostgreSQL, queues, category matching, translation memory.
Channable, supplier feed sync over CSV, XML, FTP and SFTP, scheduled pipelines, scrapers, automated reporting, GitHub Actions.

model gateways with routing, retries, a circuit breaker and cost tracking; evals for mapping quality; embeddings with pgvector; agentic workflows, such as a site monitor whose agent opens pull requests with fixes.
